story: Gary, still touched, accepts Rosa's invitation to dinner at her place tonight at six and promises to leave the cart talk in the garage. Donna has reserved pickleball court 1 for an hour starting now, and she is waiting for him so he can get embarrassed on the court. Meanwhile, Hal is filing a report at Town Hall on cart lights and wiring that have no approval on record, a problem G
events: Donna (court reservation kiosk): Reserve pickleball court 1 for one hour, starting now, under Donna Pruitt
Hal (architectural review desk): File report: Kowalski cart lights and wiring, no approval on record; Gary admitted it himself

gary.thought_process: Rosa has invited me to dinner twice now and I haven't answered. It's a nice gesture, and being needed at a table is better than an empty kitchen. I'll accept warmly and tell her I'm off to keep my promise to Donna at the Rec Center. After this I should head there. The cart rig can wait until after pickleball, and I still need Architectural Review approval for the exterior mods.

parameters.content: Rosa, you've twisted my arm, I'll be there. I'll bring a bottle of something and leave the cart talk in the garage. Now I've got to go get embarrassed at pickleball, Donna's waiting on me.

donna.thought_process: Gary caved and agreed to thirty minutes, so he's on his way. He's not in sight yet and I already invited him, so no sense chasing him with more talk. Better to make use of the time and lock down a court so nobody poaches it on a sunny Saturday. I'll book court 1 for one hour, well under the 2-hour limit in L-05, which leaves room if he turns out to be a natural. Then I'll get the spare paddle ready and the coffee going.

parameters.content: Reserve pickleball court 1 for one hour, starting now, under Donna Pruitt

hal.thought_process: I'm at Town Hall with my goal in front of me. Gary admitted himself that the lights and sound need Architectural Review sign-off, and that he's wiring first and filing after. That's backwards, and it falls under L-01. My notebook entry on the Kowalski cart is still open. Donna's flamingos likely break L-02, but I haven't counted them, so I shouldn't claim a number. Rosa's dinner invitation is still in mind, so I'll keep the report factual and not nasty. The architectural_review_desk is the right place to file it. No one else is around, so I'll get it done.

parameters.content: File report: Kowalski cart lights and wiring, no approval on record; Gary admitted it himself

rosa.thought_process: Gary and Donna are off to the rec center, and Hal went to Town Square. I've invited all three but never given a time, and a vague invite is how dinners die. Gary is right here and will see Donna in a minute, so I'll give him the time and ask him to pass it along. I won't re-invite him. I'll catch Hal in Town Square after.

parameters.content: Gary, since you're headed to the courts with Donna: dinner's tonight at six, my place. Tell her for me, and go easy on the paddle, I need you in one piece to eat.

matters.text: Hal Weems: File report: Kowalski cart lights and wiring, no approval on record; Gary admitted it himself

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
